about: The strings plan 179.1-87 writes, as its checkpoint (Task 1) presents them, each at its recommended answer: the da and sv values that are the English of the base locale, which the per-value comparison of the untranslated-catalogue guard finds once it reads every locale other than en (the operator's ruling C5 at the WR16J UAT, test 13), the one sv value that is en's behind a locale tag, and en's feedback.error.emailSubject, whose typo the UAT found. en is the source each translation was made from; for feedback.error.emailSubject it is the corrected value plan 87 writes. da and sv are machine translations, flagged for a native reader. Where the operator's answer edits a string, plan 87 replaces that value here, word for word, before anything is written, and commits this file alone. 179.1-approved-strings.mjs reads this file together with every other 179.1-<n>-approved-strings.json beside it and compares the catalogues with all of them, per locale and key.
